subject: POC infra dependencies - milestone alignment & owner commitments
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@gridlytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC infra dependencies - milestone alignment & owner commitments

Alex / Samir — thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. Quick playback and proposed owner/target dates for the MAP milestone about environment setup so we can scope the POC and lock the pilot window. Please confirm owners and any blockers by EOD Friday.

High level (agreed on call):
- VPC peering: Gridlytics to request peering config; Redwood to provide CIDR whitelist and peering acceptance policy. Owner (Grid): Samir Patel. Target: 2027-06-28.
- IP allowlist / egress rules: Grid infra to provide public egress IPs and (if needed) a NAT design. Owner (Grid): Samir. Target: 2027-06-25.
- SSO / SAML: Grid SSO team to provide metadata and test app; Redwood will supply SAML test endpoint + instructions. Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer. Target: 2027-06-29 (test sign-on).
- Secrets / KMS access: Need a limited service key or a cross-account KMS grant for the POC agent. Action: Grid security team to present preferred mechanism; Redwood to provide example grant policy. Owner: Alex (Grid) / Karthik (Redwood). Target: 2027-06-30.

I've attached the current MAP draft (MAP-draft-v0.3.xlsx) with a row per milestone and a stub for acceptance criteria. If anything in the list above is incorrect or missing, reply with corrections inline. Our ask: confirmation of owners + dates so we can finalize the pilot calendar and reserve Dedicated capacity.

Next steps that Redwood will take once owners/dates are confirmed:
- Deliver a runbook snippet for SAML test flows and a minimal IAM policy for the POC agent.
- Share a short peering template (CloudFormation / Terraform snippet) to speed up PRs.
- Schedule a 30-minute connectivity dry-run the week of 2027-06-28.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0196
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-draft-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), vpc-peering-diagram.png (image)

From: Alex Rivera <alex@gridlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gridlytics.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC infra dependencies - milestone alignment & owner commitments

Soojin — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming initial commitments from Gridlytics side:
- VPC peering: Samir will kick off the peering request tomorrow. We will use the provided peering CIDR you send; expected acceptance on our side by 2027-06-27.
- IP allowlist: We can provide static egress IPs. Ops is fine to add Redwood to allowlist once we have the ASN/CIDRs.
- SSO/SAML: That's owned by our IAM team — I will forward the SAML metadata and a contact (emma@gridlytics.com) by EOD Thursday. We may need a short test app URL from you for the SP metadata.
- KMS / secrets: Our security lead prefers a cross-account KMS grant rather than a shared plaintext secret. Samir and I need the grant example/policy to validate with our security team.

Questions / small clarifications:
- Do you need a dedicated peering connection or are transit/VPN options acceptable for the POC? (We have an existing VPN to our cloud provider.)
- For SAML, does Redwood support IdP-initiated flow for the POC or only SP-initiated?

I'll loop in Samir (infra) and Emma (IAM) in a follow-up thread. Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Rivera
Head of Product, Gridlytics
alex@gridlytics.com
+1 212 555 0148

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC infra dependencies - milestone alignment & owner commitments

Thanks Alex / Soojin — quick responses from our side:
- Peering vs VPN: For the pilot we can accept either, but peering gives the simplest low-latency path and predictable routing for tokenized requests. If you prefer VPN we can provide port-level expectations and health-checks.
- SAML flows: Redwood's test harness supports both SP and IdP-initiated flows for SAML; for day-zero validation we recommend SP-initiated (simpler to debug). We'll provide a test SP metadata URL and a minimal SAML test checklist (attached: saml-test-checklist.md).
- KMS grant: I'll attach an example cross-account grant snippet and a minimal IAM policy for the POC agent. Ben — can you own prepping the runbook snippets (peering TF, grant example, allowlist template) and upload to the shared Drive?

Ben: recommend we pre-stage the following artifacts by 2027-06-24 so Grid can review:
  1) peering Terraform snippet + acceptance checklist
  2) sample KMS grant JSON + explanation of grant TTL and least-privilege keys
  3) SAML test checklist and SP metadata endpoint

If these sound good I'll drop the artifacts into the MAP spreadsheet and mark Redwood as owner for those runbook items.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
Karthik Iyer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Great — appreciate the quick confirmations. Finalizing the MAP row updates and reserving the POC slot for the week of 2027-07-05 contingent on these items completing on the timelines above.

Quick commitment summary (final for MAP):
- VPC peering: Samir (Grid) — expected acceptance 2027-06-27.
- IP allowlist: Samir (Grid) — whitelist provided 2027-06-25.
- SAML test: Karthik (Redwood) to provide SP metadata and checklist by 2027-06-23 (done, see attached). Grid to provide IdP metadata by 2027-06-24.
- KMS: Alex / Samir (Grid) + Karthik (Redwood) — grant example provided by Redwood 2027-06-23; Grid to confirm preferred mechanism by 2027-06-30.

Ben has uploaded the runbook snippets to the shared MAP folder: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/poc-sso-kms (shared link). Please review the peering snippet and KMS grant example; call out any compliance requirements that would block a POC key grant.

If Grid can confirm the IdP metadata and KMS preference by 2027-06-30 we'll lock the POC kickoff on 2027-07-05 and Karthik will run the connectivity dry-run the week prior. If anything shifts on your side, flag it here and we'll re-sync.

Thanks —
Soojin
